purpose: Canonical ordered keyword grammar for the DIO/ODI corpus and its derived public surfaces. It stabilizes lexical identity, preserves conceptual structure, and provides deterministic keyword projections for publications, product artefacts and page-level frontends.
principles: Keywords are an ordered metadata grammar, not an unordered bag of tags.
Chunk order is invariant across the corpus and its approved derived artefact profiles.
The identity invariant C0 is always exported in full and always appears first.
C1 is a global candidate vocabulary of reconstruction environments; each object explicitly selects only the environments substantively relevant to that object.
Within master chunks, selected terms retain the same relative order across works.
K6 is exported as a complete ordered block or not exported at all.
Work-specific positioning terms occupy C2 and may vary by work or artefact.
Aliases support recognition but are not exported by default.
Keyword assignment must not retroactively project concepts into an object that the object does not substantively carry.
Exportable metadata surfaces preserve the complete resolved keyword sequence for the relevant object profile whenever the target format supports it; do not create manually curated parallel subsets.

export_policy.flattening_rule: Concatenate active chunks in chunk_order; preserve term order inside each chunk; omit inactive terms; deduplicate case-insensitively without reordering.
export_policy.projection_rule: For a supported metadata surface, resolve and export the complete ordered keyword sequence for the relevant object profile without manual curation. C0 is always complete; C1 is an explicit ordered selection from the global environment candidate pool. Apply a reduced projection only when a verified target-format constraint requires it, and document that deterministic projection separately.
export_policy.c1_selection: Each profile must explicitly list only the C1 reconstruction environments substantively relevant to its object. The literal selector 'all' is not permitted for C1; use an explicit ordered array, including an empty array where none applies.
